$comment: inferred:true for the ENTIRE FILE — no source document defines edge-case data. These fixtures exist to let design work proceed on states the requirements explicitly flag as needing definition (see product/open-questions.md) without waiting for those questions to be answered. Treat every value here as a design placeholder to validate with the Product Owner, not a confirmed spec.

zero_verified_reviews.$comment: Needed to design the Trust Verdict empty state — product/open-questions.md #2 explicitly defers this to a future UX workshop that hasn't happened yet. This fixture is a starting point for that workshop, not its output.
zero_verified_reviews.design_question: requirements.md §5 block 4.3 says the Trust Verdict block renders only if verified reviews exist; what shows instead is undefined. Candidate copy (NOT approved, drafted only to unblock layout): 'Martin Immo n'a pas encore reçu d'avis vérifié par Opinion System.' — mark [NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW] before use per CLAUDE.md working rules.

all_unverified_no_external.$comment: Stress-tests whether a page reads as trustworthy when it has real volume but zero verified reviews — the opposite failure mode from the main fixture, useful for checking the unverified block doesn't accidentally dominate the layout.

single_agency_vs_multi_agency.$comment: requirements.md §5 block 4.11 (store locator) implies a group rating exists only when there is more than one agency. No source document specifies the single-agency behavior explicitly.

high_volume_low_rating.$comment: Tests the 'no arbitrary filtering' honesty principle from research/competitive-landscape.md — a business with a genuinely mixed record, to check the design doesn't visually apologize for or hide negative reviews.
